# f5xc_ip_prefix_set (Resource)

An ip prefix set contains an unordered list of IP prefixes. It can can be used to whitelist or blacklist specific IP prefixes via network policy or service policy.

To get more information about f5xc_ip_prefix_set, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/ip-prefix-set)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Ip Prefix Set - Full

resource "f5xc_ip_prefix_set" "example" {
  name        = "example-ips"
  namespace   = "default"
  description = "Full ip prefix set example"

  labels = {
    env = "example"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "platform-team"
  }

  ipv4_prefixes = [
    {
      ipv4_prefix = "10.0.0.0/8"
      description = "Private class A"
    },
    {
      ipv4_prefix = "192.168.0.0/16"
      description = "Private class C"
    }
  ]

  ipv6_prefixes = [
    {
      ipv6_prefix = "2001:0db8:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000/32"
      description = "Documentation prefix"
    }
  ]
}
```
